answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to stake a small deposit before joining a shared voyage of work, with the stake slashed if peers catch fake identities. Like a quill signing a ledger, every action carries a verifiable signature tied to that stake, so creating thousands of sock-puppets means locking up real capital for each one. A juniper-style reputation graph then weights attestations by how long an identity has behaved honestly, making fresh fake accounts nearly worthless until they earn trust over time.
